name: Motor Inn Auto — Inventory MCP
description: Agent-callable, read-only access to Motor Inn Auto's live vehicle inventory (new and used).

tools.name: search_inventory
tools.description: Search this dealer's live inventory (new and used) by make, model, trim, body style, condition, year, price, mileage, minimum seats or maximum estimated monthly payment (payment_max, at the dealer's published financing assumptions). Results are sorted mechanically (sort: price_asc default, price_desc, mileage_asc, year_desc, payment_asc) and paged: pass the returned next_offset as offset to get more. Every row has a url on the dealer's site.

tools.name: get_vehicle_by_vin
tools.description: Get the full record for one vehicle by VIN: specs, description, photos, price, availability and the listing URL.

tools.name: get_vehicle_by_stock
tools.description: Get the full record for one vehicle by stock number: specs, description, photos, price, availability and the listing URL.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check whether a specific vehicle (by stock number or VIN) is still available, read live from the listing.
